searchText: How is ETH refunded in type 2 transactions? Or does it simply not leave the wallet the same way it is for all other transactions How is it refunded for other transactions? when you make a transaction you end up in all cases with an effective gas price and a maximum gas limit your account must be able to pay for this gas price * gas limit which you can think about being escrowed for the duration of your transactions execution if you end up spending less gas than your gas limit, you get a "refund" which is returned from the "escrow" to your account Can you explain what the escrow is? Is it just the money that's in limbo? yes
